# vector spec mutate

Mutate the changed lines and refuse mutants the test misses.

## Usage

```text
vector spec mutate <contract.json> [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="&lt;contract.json&gt;" required>

the contract

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="--base" type="&lt;ref&gt;">

the commit the change is against

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--nish-root" type="&lt;dir&gt;">

a nish checkout: finds the module and the compiler

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--nish" type="&lt;bin&gt;">

the nish compiler (default: nish)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--jobs" type="&lt;n&gt;">

mutants run at once (default 1)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--max" type="&lt;n&gt;">

at most this many mutants, spread over the changed lines

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--format" type="&lt;f&gt;">

text (default), markdown (a PR comment) or json

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>

## Exit codes

0 when the check passed, 1 when `vector` refused the input, 2 for bad usage or an I/O or tool failure; see [exit codes](../command-line.md#exit-codes).
